data.title: Lazy .pcol payload-sidecar attach at engine open (bn-bka2)
data.description:
SealedSegmentIndex::open no longer std::fs::reads whole .pcol sidecars. SealedPayloadIndex::open reads header+footer+block index only (bounded by block count) and retains the fd; block bytes are pread on first touch. from_bytes stays eager; open_eager keeps whole-image content_crc for archive_reblock and mess-cli verify.

Corruption-timing shift: content_crc cannot be verified without reading everything, so the two reserved format fields now carry crc32c of the block index (header) and of each block (block entry), gated by new header flag FLAG_SPLIT_CRC. Lazy open checksums the block index; a block is checksummed before decode. DATA-region damage surfaces at first read of that block as PayloadError::Corrupt, which callers already degrade on (raw log is payload authority, D1/I5). Pre-bn-bka2 sidecars (flags==0) still attach and read.

Measured (same binary, ABBA, 1k streams/100-event batches/250B payloads):
  8.006 GiB: open 727.9 ms -> 13.3 ms, RSS 2417 MB -> 22.7 MB
  2.001 GiB: open 181.0 ms -> 4.3 ms, RSS 609 MB -> 9.1 MB
  sealed read of 40 whole streams: 1.75 -> 1.69 M ev/s (within noise)
mess-bench full ABBA (trunk/bka2/bka2/trunk): all 14 floors PASS in all four runs.
Tests: mess-index 144 pass (6 new), mess-store 185 pass.
